verdict.rationale: Yapily supports background-running automations such as scheduled/recurring payments and variable recurring payments without re-authorisation, plus webhooks for real-time monitoring of payment/status changes, which are the mechanisms an AI-native integrator could use to build autonomous background flows. However, this is generic payments-API automation, not an AI-agent-specific orchestration or scheduling tool, and there's no evidence of agent-driven setup or management of these automations. Missing for 10: dedicated agent/automation orchestration layer, evidence of AI agents actually configuring or monitoring these schedules autonomously, and any workflow/scheduling UI beyond raw API primitives.
